_doc: Where each Meshy body's skull is, in the shell's model space (metres, +z = face, before the body's draw scale). Measured from the GLBs (nose, ears, forehead, the homme's hair cap). Used by scripts/avatar/add-hair.mjs (the 'shave' morph target; `neck`: the radius the nape's hair is taken in to — the homme's short hair lies on his neck, so it only sinks to just under it) and src/actors/hairStyles.ts (the hair and headwear built on the head).
